sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def marker_pos():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    pts=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','S') and n['pixels']<40:
            b=n['boundary']; cs=[p[1] for p in b]; pts.append((min(cs),max(cs),n['color']))
    pts.sort()
    return pts
print("start:",marker_pos())
for i in range(10):
    res=action(['LEFT'])
    if res.get('level_completed') or res.get('done') or res.get('game_over'):
        print("STOP at iter",i,"res:",{k:res.get(k) for k in ('level_completed','done','game_over','run_complete')})
        break
    print(i+1, marker_pos())
print("final level_completed:",last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
